name: conversus
description: Multi-agent deliberation engine — run competitive reviews, red-team proposals, and build consensus
long_description: Conversus is an open-source multi-agent deliberation engine that uses game theory modes (cooperative, winner-take-all, prisoner's dilemma, red-blue) to drive structured adversarial review, convergence, and dispute resolution across LLM agents. Use it to run competitive reviews, red-team proposals, evaluate decisions, and synthesize consensus from multiple AI perspectives. This bundle is self-contained — no separate Python or pip install required.

tools.name: conversus_validate
tools.description: Validate a conversus YAML configuration without executing

tools.name: conversus_run
tools.description: Validate a config and optionally run a deliberation or parse existing output

tools.name: conversus_decide
tools.description: Run an ad-hoc deliberation on a natural-language question using game theory modes
